profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Textron Aviation
profile.summary:
As a kid, I always wanted to invent things that improved people's lives. I suppose six-year-old me wasn't far off! I have been programming for over a decade now. I began as a self-taught programmer using Java for personal projects in seventh grade, and earned a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Kansas State University in 2020.

I have worked on several projects in my time at college, including a frontend program for analyzing images taken from a drone of a target on the ground. Upon graduating, I accepted a position at VIAVI Solutions, LLC, working on radio test and alignment automation using Python. There, I was the primary developer in charge of integrating Icom 7000- and 7500-series radios into the test program. I then accepted a position at Textron Aviation, Inc. as a software engineer in the Instrumentation Group, working on applications that supported the collection and processing of real-time instrumentation data from experimental aircraft. These are applications written in C# using Windows Presentation Framework. I now work on the Tools, Processes, and Program Management team in the Avionics and Electrical Systems department, producing in-house tools that streamline engineering workflows.

I like to occupy my admittedly limited spare time with volunteer service, usually with Civil Air Patrol, the civilian auxiliary of the U.S. Air Force.  It's not unheard of for me to shuffle around my personal time to attend a training mission or multitask my evenings away with my various duties. I am also a private pilot.

I am proficient using C, C#, Python, Java, Rust, JavaScript, Typescript, HTML/CSS, and various implementations of SQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a member of the Cybersecurity and Tools team, I am responsible for developing new software tools to support and automate work in the Avionics and Electrical Systems department across all active programs, including both desktop and web programming. I am also the primary engineer overseeing cybersecurity analysis on the Cessna Citation CJ4 Gen3 platform. This involves the full DO-326 process, including planning, scope definition, risk assessment, and penetration testing.

positions.title: Instrumentation Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for the development and maintenance of applications used by the instrumentation group. Projects were written primarily in C# using WPF as a frontend framework and Microsoft SQL Server as a data source. They fulfilled purposes including tracking requests for instrumentation to be added to aircraft, applying calculations to raw data to convert them into engineering units, and transmission and display of live telemetry data.
positions.insights: Full-Stack Development, Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) and +18 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked directly on the CX-300 radio test set's Autotest feature. This application controls the test instruments and sends commands to a connected radio to test its various parameters, such as frequency deviation or power level.
positions.insights: Agile Environment, Real-time Control Systems and +9 skills

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: As an intern and a member of the Corps of Volunteers, I was responsible for assisting the IT department with infrastructure changes and maintenance, such as the creation and storage of offsite backups and ensuring that the most security-sensitive systems received regular updates.

volunteerExperiences.role: Director of Aerospace Education - External, Kansas Wing
volunteerExperiences.description: I am an Aerospace Education Officer with CAP, the civilian auxiliary of the U.S. Air Force, teaching cadets and the public the basics of flight, aviation history, rocketry, and more, with scope over the state of Kansas. Established in 1941, Civil Air Patrol is the official auxiliary of the U.S. Air Force and as such is a member of its Total Force. In its auxiliary role, CAP operates a fleet of 555 single-engine aircraft and 2,250 small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) and performs about 90% of all search and rescue operations within the contiguous United States as tasked by the Air Force Rescue Coordination Center. Often using innovative cellphone forensics and radar analysis software, CAP was credited by the AFRCC with saving 108 lives last year. CAP’s 58,000 members also perform homeland security, disaster relief and drug interdiction missions at the request of federal, state and local agencies. As a nonprofit organization, CAP plays a leading role in aerospace education using national academic standards-based STEM (science, technology, engineering and math) education resources. Members also serve as mentors to over 24,000 young people participating in CAP’s Cadet Programs.

I am currently commander of the Air Capital Composite Squadron. In this position, I am responsible for leading Wichita's finest force of civilian volunteers. I oversee the development of 50 young future leaders and 30 adult staff, the accomplishment of hundreds of emergency activations annually, and the furtherance of Wichita area STEM education. I currently hold the grade of Captain and additional ratings in aerospace education, communications, information technology, personnel, administration, and emergency services.

organizations.name: Esports Club at Kansas State University
organizations.description: As President, I was responsible for oversight of the nearly 20 teams and 80 people that make up our organization. Together with my talented officers and junior officers, I have restructured the club, begun an in-house marketing program, and created teams that compete at the national level. My goal as President was to grow our membership numbers to provide a fun and engaging experience for all.

organizations.name: KSU Student Unmanned Aerial Systems
organizations.position: Image Analysis Team Leader · May 2018 - Jun 2020
organizations.description: I lead a team that developed image analysis software for unmanned aircraft.  Our efforts focused on integrating machine learning into our workflow for competitions.
